name: extract_entities
description: Extract structured entities from user message for RFQ creation workflow. Can handle multiple products in a single message. Delivery location and date are GLOBAL fields that apply to all products. Focus only on entity extraction - completeness checking is handled by the data model.

products.description: Array of product entities extracted from the message. Each product contains item-specific fields only.

description.description: Item description. Use empty string if not provided.

quantity.description: HOW MANY items/units the user wants. Extract only when explicitly stated. IMPORTANT: '500m cable' has NO quantity stated (500m is product specification, like '1000ml bottle'). '100kg rice' has NO quantity (100kg is bag size). Only extract when clearly stated: '5 cables' -> 5, '100 bottles' -> 100, '10 bags' -> 10. If not explicitly stated, use null. Examples: '500m cable Polycab' -> null (need to ask: how many 500m cables?), '1000ml bottles' -> null (need to ask: how many bottles?), '5 laptops' -> 5, '10 bags of rice' -> 10.

unitofMeasures.description: Unit of measurement INCLUDING the numeric value for measured items. Use 'unit(s)' ONLY for pure countable items (laptops, chairs, printers). For items with weight/length/volume/area specifications, include the FULL measurement. Examples: '700 salt bags 50kg each' -> '50 kg', '200kg steel bars' -> '200 kg', '25 meters cable' -> '25 meters', '50ml water bottles' -> '50 ml', '2500 sq mtr vinyl' -> '2500 sq mtr', '100 laptops' -> 'unit(s)', '5 chairs' -> 'unit(s)'. EXCEPTION: Electrical ratings (KV, mAh, watts, ampere) are SPECIFICATIONS not measurements - those go to remarks and UoM should be 'unit(s)'. Use empty string if no unit is mentioned.

brand.description: Preferred brand name for this item. Use empty string if not provided.

remarks.description: Item-specific remarks, requirements, or technical specifications. Include: (1) Electrical ratings like KV, mAh, watts, ampere (e.g., '1000KV', '5000mAh'); (2) Technical specifications like 'FR-LSH 4Cx10sqmm 1100V', '3Cx2.5sqmm+1Cx1.5sqmm(E)', '16GB RAM', '2TB SSD'; (3) Physical properties like thickness, density, material; (4) Other requirements. NOTE: Weight/length/volume/area measurements (kg, meters, ml, sq mtr) go to unitofMeasures field, NOT here. Examples: 'Laptop 16GB RAM' -> '16GB RAM', 'cable FR-LSH 4Cx10sqmm 1100V' -> 'FR-LSH 4Cx10sqmm 1100V', 'motors 1000KV' -> '1000KV', 'vinyl 7.5mm thick' -> '7.5mm thick'. Use empty string if no specifications provided.

deliveryDate.description: Required delivery date (applies to all products). Use empty string if not provided.

state.description: Delivery state for all products (e.g., Karnataka, Maharashtra, etc.). Use empty string if not provided.

city.description: Delivery city for all products (e.g., Bangalore, Mumbai, etc.). Use empty string if not provided.

pincode.description: Delivery pincode for all products (6-digit postal code). Use empty string if not provided.

confidence.description: Confidence in the entity extraction accuracy
